standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of an \mathcal{O}_X-module of finite type: every point has a neighbourhood on which finitely many sections generate the module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on modules of finite type, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Formulates both directions of the equivalence.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the stalk of a direct image sheaf and the surjectivity of \mathcal{O}_X \to i_*\mathcal{O}_Z at the points of the closed subset
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 2140-2142
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the proof conclude surjectivity of the displayed map from its behaviour on stalks.

core_obligations: Points outside the image: for a point of the closed subset's complement the direct image vanishes on a neighbourhood, so finite generation there is automatic (proof lines 2126-2129)

Direct implication: choosing a neighbourhood of a point of the closed subset on which the module is generated by finitely many sections and writing it as the trace of an open neighbourhood in the ambient space, the proof shows that the same sections generate the direct image over that neighbourhood, using the surjectivity of the structural map on stalks (proof lines 2129-2143)

Converse: starting from finitely many sections generating the direct image over a neighbourhood, the proof passes to the trace on the closed subset where they correspond to sections of the original module, and concludes surjectivity again by inspection on stalks (proof lines 2145-2159)
proof_roadmap: 正向：x ∉ Z 时 i_*F 在 x 附近为 0；x = i(z) 时取 z ∈ V ⊂ Z 与生成元 s_1,…,s_n，写 V = Z ∩ U，则同一批 s_i 作为 i_*F 在 U 上的截面给出的 ⊕O_U → i_*F|_U 在茎上满（用到 O_X → i_*O_Z 满）。
反向：设 i_*F 在 U 上由 s_1,…,s_n 生成，令 V = Z ∩ U，则相应的 s_i ∈ F(V) 给出的 ⊕O_V → F|_V 在茎上满。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of ringed spaces which is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset with surjective structural map, a module is of finite type exactly when its direct image is (author lemma at source lines 2115-2123, label lemma-i-star-reflects-finite-type). The proof (source lines 2125-2160) treats the points outside and inside the closed subset separately and reduces both directions to the behaviour of the displayed generating maps on stalks, using the surjectivity of the structural map at the points of the closed subset (proof lines 2129-2143 and 2145-2159). Both directions are proved by the same stalkwise inspection, and no reference external to the span is used. H2.
